content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

I need a box, that is on the upside open. The outer dimensions are 220 x 300 x 160mm. The wall thickness should be 8mm and the bottom thickness 12mm | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step plan (verbally only)

1. Prepare an outer solid block that has the full outside dimensions  
   • x-size = 220 mm, y-size = 300 mm, z-size = 160 mm  
   • Basepoint at the global origin (0, 0, 0)  
   • This block is added to the scene (subtraction = False).  
   This establishes the external shape of the box.

2. Prepare an inner “cavity” block that will be removed from the outer block to create the hollow interior and open top  
   • Wall thickness is 8 mm all around, so the cavity starts 8 mm in from each side: basepoint (8, 8, …) in X and Y.  
   • Bottom thickness is 12 mm, so the cavity starts 12 mm above the global Z-origin: basepoint Z = 12 mm.  
   • Cavity dimensions = (220 − 2·8) = 204 mm in X, (300 − 2·8) = 284 mm in Y, and (160 − 12) = 148 mm in Z.  
   • This block is marked for subtraction (subtraction = True).  
   Removing this volume leaves 8 mm-thick side walls and a 12 mm-thick bottom, while the top remains open.

3. After both block definitions, call the “finished” function to signal that all geometry operations are complete.

Summary of the required function calls (to be executed later):
• One block() call containing two blocks (outer added, inner subtracted).  
• One finished() call.

Let me know when you’d like me to prepare the actual function-call JSON.

Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
